top_concerns: VARE trains on teacher-forced original-model tokens but inference uses self-generated tokens; the mismatch is unaddressed and error accumulation is shown only qualitatively
Baselines are self-ported diffusion losses that collapse by construction; the closest AR erasure work (EAR) is not compared, so 'first effective' is unsupported
'Surgical'/'robust' overstated: common-content count roughly halves (112->57), training and test use one fixed lexical form ('naked'), no synonym or adaptive-attack evaluation
Thin evaluation: single model (Infinity-2B), one main concept per type, no seeds or variance, single detectors
Eq. 7-10 are ill-defined or sign/direction-inconsistent, and the CE-vs-KL and KL-direction choices are justified only by speculation
